dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My ambition is to become a translator. Languages are my passion.
dialogue.reading: maɪ æmˈbɪʃən ɪz tə bɪˈkʌm ə trænsˈleɪtər. ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz ər maɪ ˈpæʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And my dream is to open a small café with books. Maybe later in life.
dialogue.reading: ənd maɪ ˈdriːm ɪz tu ˈoʊpən ə ˈsmɔːl kæˈfeɪ wɪð ˈbʊks. ˈmeɪbi ˈleɪtər ɪn ˈlaɪf.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I love that idea! My aim is to find a job in Asia after I graduate.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈðæt aɪˈdiːə! maɪ ˈeɪm ɪz tə ˈfaɪnd ə ˈdʒɑːb ɪn ˈeɪʒə ˈæftər aɪ ˈɡrædʒueɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope so. Living here gave me the opportunity to learn about a new culture.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ˈlɪvɪŋ ˈhɪr ˈɡeɪv miː ði ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tə ˈlɜːrn əˈbaʊt ə ˈnuː ˈkʌltʃər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what was the purpose of your exchange at the start?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈpɜːrpəs əv jʊr ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ət ðə ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: To study Asian business. But I think its real purpose was to meet people like you!
dialogue.reading: tə ˈstʌdi ˈeɪʒən ˈbɪznəs. bʌt aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈriːəl ˈpɜːrpəs wʌz tə ˈmiːt ˈpiːpəl laɪk ˈjuː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, Emma! Then promise me one thing.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈɛmə! ˈðɛn ˈprɑːmɪs miː ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If you get the chance to come back, take it!
dialogue.reading: ɪf juː ˈɡɛt ðə ˈtʃæns tə ˈkʌm ˈbæk, ˈteɪk ɪt!
